I am an old woman here in Mtwara, and my strength is not what it used to be. This maize plot is small, less than one hectare, and I grow it together with my pigeon peas and cassava like we have always done. I have no money for chemical fertilizer or spraying, and the rains here must do the watering — there is no irrigation in my field. I will use the seeds I saved from last season, put some manure from my goats on the plot, and my children and grandchildren will come to help me weed and harvest.
